items.title: Synthetic public opinion polling: AI personas don't always change their minds like real voters do
items.excerpt: Pollsters now use LLM-built synthetic personas as stand-ins for voters, but fixed personas miss opinion shifts and outliers; a Pew experiment found AI answers differed from human panelists by 12 points on average.

items.title: Researchers dispute whether AI has passed the Turing test
items.excerpt: The first experimental run of Turing's original three-player, open-ended imitation game found 36 of 37 participants correctly identified GPT-4-Turbo, challenging claims that AI has passed the Turing test.

items.title: AI that reconstructs cloud-covered ground in satellite images with photo-like clarity
items.excerpt: KAIST built GeoCore-9B, a 9-billion-parameter generative foundation model pretrained on 10 million satellite image-text pairs, which restores cloud-covered optical imagery and turns radar images into photo-like views, beating task-specific models.

history_match.title: IonQ tests quantum generative models for change detection on real satellite radar

items.title: AI chatbots could help mental health but also reinforce harmful thinking
items.excerpt: Curtin University's Warren Mansell proposes a framework in Digital Health for how chatbot conversations widen or narrow a user's thinking depending on emotional state and replies, urging bots that prompt reflection over validation.

items.title: AI Proved the Quasi-Riemann Hypothesis. What Happens Now?
items.excerpt: Unlike other recent AI proofs, this one has been unpacked by human experts. The implications, one mathematician said, are 'staggering.'

history_match.title: AI's failed attempt to crack the Riemann hypothesis led a mathematician to a breakthrough

items.title: Researchers improve weather forecasts looking two to six weeks out
items.excerpt: MIT researchers developed a machine-learning model that learns to correct errors in existing forecasting models, sharply improving accuracy in the two-to-six-week subseasonal window key for emergency planning.

history_match.title: AI-enhanced weather model doubles predictive power two to six weeks out

items.title: Grounding AI agents in biological reality: Building blocks for autonomous wet labs
items.excerpt: Google Research paired AI agents with lab robots and a digital twin (VERID) that verifies liquid-handling protocols before execution, running closed-loop campaigns on DNA aptamers and de novo protein binders that reached single-digit nanomolar binders.

history_match.title: Hybrid Digital Twins Developed for Future Autonomous Labs

items.title: Putting Earth AI to work: Geospatial agents for our planet's biggest challenges
items.excerpt: Google Research released a technical report on a Geospatial Reasoning agent combining Earth AI foundation models with planning, plus two new benchmarks; specialized tools beat standalone LLMs on spatial tasks used for outbreak exposure mapping and disaster preparedness.

history_match.title: Unlocking Earth AI's planetary geospatial foundation models for global public health

items.title: Can math stay human in the age of AI?
items.excerpt: As AI churns out mathematical proofs, a DeepMind study raises a bigger question: What do we lose when we focus only on the answers?

items.title: Physicists develop early warning system that predicts when an AI is about to go rogue
items.excerpt: A new mathematical formula tracks an AI's internal 'compass needle' to flag undesirable outputs before they happen.

history_match.title: Simple math formula predicts when AI chatbots will go rogue

items.title: Microsoft's split-personality retrosynthetic AI is a fast learner
items.excerpt: RetroChimera combines two deep learning algorithms from different classes, outperforming their individual success rates on retrosynthesis datasets from Novartis and GSK.

items.title: A supercomputer is about to launch to the moon aboard a rover named FLIP
items.excerpt: The FLIP lunar rover will carry the first supercomputer to the moon, bringing onboard AI processing to lunar surface operations.

items.title: AI reveals a hidden chemical shortcut that could turn CO2 into fuel
items.excerpt: IISc researchers combined quantum-mechanics simulations with machine-learning energy-barrier models to map 9,389 reactions on a copper catalyst, uncovering CO2-conversion pathways traditional models missed.

history_match.title: Using machine learning and computation to unveil mechanisms for CO2-to-fuel conversion

items.title: Mysterious brain activity under anesthesia challenges what we know about consciousness
items.excerpt: Baylor researchers found that even under general anesthesia the brain analyzes language and predicts what comes next in a story, a next-word prediction pattern they liken to large language models.

items.title: Filling the gaps in global rainfall maps
items.excerpt: Chiba University researchers treat sequences of global precipitation maps like video, using a conditional diffusion model with a 3D U-Net to fill satellite observation gaps from neighboring frames and regions; it beat other deep-learning methods on simulated gaps.
